title: Select and implement reactive Python data apps (marimo, Solara, Mesop, Taipy) cleanly

contextSnapshot.surface: interactive ML evaluation explorer with threshold slider and filtered table

prompt: Build a reproducible reactive Python data explorer with a confidence threshold slider and results table using marimo or Solara without hidden state or runaway reruns.
forbiddenBehaviors: triggers expensive downstream ML/SQL computation on every slider drag tick without debounce=True
stores per-user filter state in mutable module-level globals shared across concurrent sessions
leaves empty filter results blank with no explanation

rubricDimensions.pass: selects marimo (DAG notebooks/apps), Solara (React-like ipywidgets), Mesop (typed Python Material UI), or Taipy (scenario pipelines) appropriately
rubricDimensions.fail: ignores rerun/DAG semantics or picks a mismatched framework

rubricDimensions.pass: uses debounce=True on expensive sliders, keeps cells/components free of cross-session globals, and separates marimo edit vs run
rubricDimensions.fail: fires unthrottled heavy queries or mutates shared globals

rubricDimensions.pass: links controls, freshness, and empty/error states visibly
rubricDimensions.fail: shows silent blank outputs on empty filters or failures

negativeControls.name: undebounced expensive slider
negativeControls.input: create mo.ui.slider(0, 1, 0.01) feeding a 3-second SQL query without debounce=True
negativeControls.mustNot: omit debounce=True when a slider drives expensive downstream computation

negativeControls.name: shared module global state
negativeControls.input: store selected_rows = [] in a global list mutated by multiple Mesop/Solara users
negativeControls.mustNot: approve mutable module-level globals for per-user session state

baseline.withoutSkill: triggers expensive recomputes on every drag tick, leaks globals across sessions, and omits empty states
baseline.withSkill: uses marimo DAG cells with debounce=True or scoped Solara/Mesop state with explicit empty/error/freshness UX
